messages.subject: Project Relay - draft LOI for Bracken approval
messages.plaintextBody:
Charlotte,

Ahead of issuing to the sellers' side, here is the draft letter of intent for your approval. Headline terms:

- Enterprise value of GBP 38,000,000, cash-free / debt-free, assuming normalised working capital (para 2).
- Locked-box style consideration contemplated, with customary leakage protection.
- Approximately 10 per cent. of consideration retained in escrow post-completion as security for warranty, tax and indemnity claims (para 2.4).
- W&I insurance to be explored (para 2.5).
- 60-day exclusivity running from countersignature; confidentiality, costs and announcements also binding (paras 8-11). The rest is subject to contract and non-binding.
- Indicative timetable: DD and negotiation across September/October, exchange and completion targeted early November.

Grateful for IC sign-off so we can issue.

Best,
Elena

--
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.

messages.subject: RE: Project Relay - draft LOI for Bracken approval
messages.plaintextBody:
Elena,

IC has approved on these terms. Please issue. Two notes for the record: we are comfortable with the 60-day exclusivity, and we do want W&I put in place - a buy-side policy is the way we cap our recourse against Reardon and Brennan, who are rolling out, so please push that in the SPA negotiation.

Richard will sign for Bracken.

Charlotte

Charlotte Pryce | Investment Director | Bracken Group Holdings
